Forrest Bowers, Acting Director

Doug Vincent-Lang, Commissioner

Headquarters Office Juneau, AK 99811-5526

Advisory Announcement

Released: 10:00 a.m. August 24, 2026

Juneau, AK 99811-5526

CONTACT: Geoff Spalinger, Area Biologist Brad Fuerst, Asst. Area Biologist Todd Anderson, Asst. Area Biologist (907) 486-1830

KODIAK COMMERCIAL SALMON FISHERY ADVISORY ANNOUNCEMENT # 41 For Emergency Order #4-FS-K-41-26

There will be a 48-hour extension to the current commercial salmon fishing period from 6:00 p.m. Monday, August 24 to 6:00 p.m. Wednesday, August 26 in the following areas:

- - - -

The Outer Karluk Section of the Southwest Kodiak District; The Central, North Cape, and Inner Uganik Bay Sections of the Northwest Kodiak District; The Southwest Afognak Section of the Afognak District; and, The Cape Alitak, Alitak Bay, Moser Bay, and Olga Bay Sections of the Alitak District.

As Previously Announced: The following areas will close as scheduled at 6:00 p.m. Monday, August 24:

- -

- - - -

The Outer Ayakulik, Halibut Bay, and Sturgeon Sections of the Southwest Kodiak District; The Terror Bay, Uyak Bay, Zachar Bay, and Spiridon Bay Sections of the Northwest Kodiak District (the Anton Larsen Bay, Sharatin Bay, and Kizhuyak Bay Sections remain closed); The Northwest Afognak and Southeast Afognak Sections of the Afognak District; The Humpy-Deadman Section of the Alitak District; The Seven Rivers, Two-Headed, and Sitkalidak Sections of the Eastside Kodiak District; and, The Northeast Kodiak District.

The following areas remain open until further notice:

-

The Duck Bay, Izhut Bay, and Outer Kitoi Bay Sections of the Afognak District.

Fishermen are reminded that in the Kodiak Area (including the Mainland District) until further notice, Chinook (king) salmon 28 inches or greater in length may not be retained by purse seine gear in the commercial fishery and must be returned to the water unharmed.

Other closed waters are as shown on the Kodiak Area Salmon Statistical Chart and detailed in the Commercial Salmon Fishing Regulations (5AAC 18.350). Statistical Charts, Harvest Strategies, and Commercial Salmon Fishing Regulations are available at the Kodiak Fish and Game office. Recent salmon fishery information may be obtained by calling the Department’s 24-hour record-a-phone at 486-4559.
